# apps-in-toss-rejections

> Real Apps in Toss (앱인토스) mini-app review rejections, the review items the official toss/apps-in-toss-harness launch scan does not automate, a zero-dependency scanner for built bundles, and an agent skill.

- [README](README.md): what this is and how to run it
- [Agent procedure](skills/apps-in-toss-rejections/SKILL.md): step-by-step for coding agents
- [Gaps](GAPS.md): 14 review items with how to verify each
- [Rejection cases](cases/README.md): real rejection messages, causes, fixes
- [Scanner](scripts/scan.mjs): `node scripts/scan.mjs <built-web-folder>`
- Official checklist: https://developers-apps-in-toss.toss.im/checklist/app-nongame
- Official UI/UX guide: https://developers-apps-in-toss.toss.im/design/consumer-ux-guide
